@id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis object. The identifier is referred by an error object and can be referred from multiple objects.

repairs.description: List of reference to repair objects containing a solution for a referring error.

heading.description: A unique and descriptive heading for the analysis.

analysis.description: The analysis of the error. String items in the array are presented as paragraphs.

significantProperties.description: The significant properties that are especially taken into account in the analysis. Significant properties may provide a perspective to the problem. String items in the array can be presented as paragraphs.

softwareProblem.description: Classification whetever the cause of the problem is in the validating software, that is a software bug, or not. Bugs should most likely be handled by the developers of the software.

fixable.description: Should a fix be determined for the error based on this analysis?
